newsitem.title: USA: Centurion finds gold, silver mineralization.
newsitem.headline: Centurion finds gold, silver mineralization.

text.p: Centurion Mines Corp said on Monday that it has discovered significant gold and silver mineralization in sedimentary rocks in a drill hole on its 100 percent owned mining properties near Kings Canyon, Millard County, Utah, about 200 miles southwest from Salt Lake City.
Drill hole CKC-96-10 in the 10 foot interval 250 to 260 feet encountered gold at a grade of 0.615 ounces per ton and silver at a grade of 2.3 ounces per ton, the company said.
Between 270 and 280 feet the gold grade was 0.112 ounces per ton. Between 430 and 450 feet the silver grade was 2.9 ounces per ton, its statement continued.
Drill hole CKC-96-10 is situated more than three miles away from the nearest previously known occurrence of commercial grade gold/silver mineralization.
Centurion said it plans to both offset and deepen drill hole CKC-96-10 and will release additional drill results when they become available.
